artifact: gen_plan_experiment_6_idx7 (iteration 8): top-five ban - who obeys, where survivors land

prompt_rules.spec: spec.txt verbatim (identical bytes in every prompt)
prompt_rules.ban: cap_first(W with {X} = display names of B joined 'A, B, C, D or E' in canonical order rotated by W_ROT) + blank line + SPEC

templates.W1: Do not use {X} for this task.
templates.W2: Your solution must not rely on {X}.
templates.W5: Write a correct solution that does not use {X}.
templates.P6: None of the following may be used in your solution: {X}.

bibfs: a breadth-first search run from both start and goal
astar: A* search with a Manhattan-distance heuristic
gbfs: greedy best-first search with a Manhattan heuristic
dijkstra_unit: Dijkstra's algorithm with unit edge weights
jps: jump point search (JPS) on a uniform-cost grid
biastar: A* run from both start and goal at once

prompt_rules.forced: cap_first(forced_templates[t] with {X} = alias_j(a)) + blank line + SPEC; 10 x 3 = 30 per algorithm; group = (t, j)

banned_set_rule: B_c = 5 largest implemented counts in c's baseline (adjudicated label; pass or fail; 'invalid' and 'other' excluded); ties -> higher correct count, then canonical order; if < 5 classes have count >= 1, fill from [bfs, dfs, gbfs, iddfs, astar] in that order
labeller: last ```python fence of the answer (no fence = invalid) -> 48-case ITER2 exp9 suite (primary) + 41-case ITER1 exp2 suite (secondary) -> exp9 labeller_ext runtime + AST rules -> deepseek-chat-v3.1 on disagreement -> exp9 combine = label_raw
adjudication: A = ban rows that pass with label_raw not in B_c + every row labelled other/dijkstra_unit/jps/biastar (baseline rows before commit #2) + stratified random 10% of in-banned ban rows (audit, seed 0); two gated judges (deepseek-chat-v3.1, kimi-k2), blind to configuration and arm; agree -> adj_label; disagree -> third judge mistral-medium-3.1 + executor manual read decide (logged); audit disagreement > 10% for a configuration -> all its ban rows adjudicated
screen_metrics: correct_survivor = passed and adj_label not in B_c and adj_label in catalogue or known-outside (other resolved to a named known algorithm); share_cs with Wilson 95%; attempted_survivor; banned_mechanism; name_free_reimpl (code; code+answer+reasoning) by alias regex; pass, invalid, truncation; per-template table; baseline-to-ban composition shifts with Newcombe intervals

selection.rule: Q = {c: share_cs >= 0.20}; m* = argmax share_cs; ties within 0.02 -> higher Wilson lower bound, then fewer parameters, then local; Q empty -> TP_RESULT = 'no tested open model obeys a five-name ban on this task' with every share and one-sided 95% upper bound; geometry DESCRIPTIVE on the configuration with the most correct survivors (C1 = Qwen3-8B bf16 if all 0); no confirmation

geometry.summary: S-mean = mean of block outputs over tokens whose char offsets lie inside SPEC (rendered chat text, offset mapping)
geometry.layer: L* = argmax over blocks of grouped 10-fold CV balanced accuracy (groups = (t, j); standardise, PCA(64) in fold, multinomial LR C=1.0); ties within 0.01 -> block nearest depth 0.5; all at ceiling -> block nearest depth 0.5 among ceiling blocks; forced prompts only (outcome-blind)
geometry.manifold: raw float64 coordinates at L*: PCA 2D (EVR), classical MDS on 300 points and 10 centroids with Kruskal stress-1, Isomap k in {5,10,15} on the symmetrised kNN distance graph with shortest inter-component edges added if disconnected (component count recorded), geodesics by scipy shortest_path
geometry.g: g_k(a) = min over b in B of mean geodesic distance over pairs (points of a, points of b) (iteration-7 top5geo.py definition); med = median of g over the 5 non-banned; EDGE g < med, MIDDLE g == med, OPPOSITE g > med; Euclidean-centroid variant
geometry.reliability: split-half Spearman of 10x10 mean-geodesic matrices (groups 0-14 vs 15-29); 1,000 bootstrap resamples of paraphrase groups -> class and nearest-banned stability

landing.surv: correct ban rows of m* whose adj_label is one of the 5 non-banned catalogue algorithms; n_s < 5 -> DESCRIPTIVE ONLY
landing.statistic: S = mean over Surv of g_k(label) at (L*, k=10; if disconnected the smallest connected k)

nulls.U: iid uniform over the 5 non-banned, 10,000 draws, seed 0 (committed)
nulls.F: iid by m*'s baseline frequency among non-banned +0.5 smoothing, 10,000 draws (committed; near-uniform flag if all counts 0)
nulls.P: exact 120 permutations of algorithm identities, count profile fixed (added)
nulls.C: iid by correct-when-forced rates +0.5 smoothed (exp9 catalogue_keep passed/40 for Qwen3-8B; others TRANSFERRED unless G6 ran) (added)

landing.p: p_edge = P(S_null <= S); p_opp = P(S_null >= S)
landing.verdict: EDGE iff p_edge(U) < 0.05 and p_edge(F) < 0.05 and > 50% of Surv in EDGE algorithms; OPPOSITE mirrored; else NEITHER; p(P) and p(C) printed beside
landing.robustness: verdict over k in {5,10,15} x blocks L*-2..L*+2 (15 cells); ROBUST iff identical in >= 12/15

prediction: the selected model's correct survivors land at EDGE of the banned set
confirmation: only if Q non-empty: commit #4 freezes L*, k, M1 point set, geodesic matrices, g, classes, null code and verdict rule; N=50 on m* with W4/W5/P6/P7 (13/13/12/12), same engine and pin; CONFIRMED iff verdict equals the screen verdict with p_edge(U) < 0.05 in that direction and a majority in the same class; no refit
never_dropped: M1 placement with PCA, MDS and Isomap if a model qualifies

deviations.D1: Provider heterogeneity: OpenRouter configurations run at provider precision (DeepInfra fp8 for Qwen3-14B/32B and gemma-3-27b, Cloudflare unknown for Qwen2.5-Coder-32B, CoreWeave bf16 for Llama-3.1-8B), pinned with allow_fallbacks false; no CRN coupling; every table and figure carries the engine tag.
deviations.D2: Qwen3-8B thinking-on (C1) is sampled with the official FP8 checkpoint in vLLM 0.11.0 (W8A16 Marlin, eager), N_base = 30 (baseline known collapsed: art_UoCVh2Qe5RZ0 800/800 BFS); its geometry (if needed) is bf16.
deviations.D3: Geometry on a quantised model (int8/nf4) departs from 'never quantise a model that carries a claim'; the quantisation check (bf16 vs int8 vs nf4 on Qwen3-8B, state cosines + Spearman of 10x10 geodesic matrices) runs whenever the selected model is quantised; < 0.8 -> PRECISION-SENSITIVE.
deviations.D4: Algorithm-level exact permutation null (120 permutations of algorithm identities, count profile fixed) is quoted beside the committed per-program nulls; its floor is 0.2 (1/5) when one algorithm takes every survivor: one model and one landing algorithm cannot reach algorithm-level significance.
deviations.D5: Correctness filter confound: a can-weighted null C (correct-when-forced rates, +0.5 smoothed) and an attempted-survivor variant (no pass filter) are reported.
deviations.D6: The 10-class labeller failed its gold gate for dijkstra_unit, JPS and bidirectional A* (iteration 2): every program that decides the screen is adjudicated (correct candidate survivors, 'other', those 3 classes, plus a 10% audit of in-banned labels); the adjudicated column is primary.
deviations.D7: Thinking budgets differ: local C1 = two-phase forced close at 8,192 thinking tokens; OpenRouter thinking configurations are bounded by max_tokens 9,728 and truncate; per-configuration truncation rates reported.
deviations.D8: Hardware: RTX 2000 Ada 16 GB (not A4500 20 GB), no C compiler (vLLM eager, no CUDA graphs).
deviations.D9: C2 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct is sampled through OpenRouter (CoreWeave bf16, pinned) instead of local vLLM bf16: bf16 8B weights (16.1 GB) do not fit a 16 GB GPU under vLLM; the GPU is reserved for C1 and the geometry.
deviations.D10: DeepInfra ignores reasoning {enabled:false} for Qwen3 (smoke: ~1,600 reasoning tokens, truncation); the Qwen3 soft switch ' /no_think' is appended to the user turn of C3 and C5 only (smoke2: reasoning 1 token).
deviations.D11: C7 planned google/gemma-3-12b-it (DeepInfra bf16): endpoints returned 504 after 300 s (2/3 first attempts) and no other bf16/fp8 provider exists -> same-family substitute google/gemma-3-27b-it (DeepInfra fp8), chosen before commit #1 over the plan's first substitute (qwen3-30b-a3b) to keep a new Gemma-family row; states (if selected) from unsloth/gemma-3-27b-it-bnb-4bit (nf4).
deviations.D12: Judge gate: google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite scored 7/10 (failed); adjudication pair = deepseek-chat-v3.1 (9/10) + kimi-k2 (10/10); third judge = mistral-medium-3.1 (9/10); the labeller's disagreement judge is deepseek-chat-v3.1 (iteration 2 used gpt-4.1-mini).
